private_artifact_content.name: private_artifact_content
private_artifact_content.value:
("private_artifact"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "private_artifact"."content" IS NOT NULL AND octet_length("private_artifact"."content") = "private_artifact"."byte_length")
        OR ("private_artifact"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "private_artifact"."content" IS NULL AND "private_artifact"."derived_text" IS NULL AND "private_artifact"."derived_kind" IS NULL)

private_artifact_derived.name: private_artifact_derived
private_artifact_derived.value:
("private_artifact"."derived_text" IS NULL AND "private_artifact"."derived_kind" IS NULL)
        OR ("private_artifact"."derived_text" IS NOT NULL AND octet_length("private_artifact"."derived_text") <= 65536 AND "private_artifact"."derived_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "private_artifact"."derived_kind" IN ('text', 'transcript'))

private_artifact_metadata.name: private_artifact_metadata
private_artifact_metadata.value:
length(trim("private_artifact"."owner_user_id")) > 0 AND length(trim("private_artifact"."workspace_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("private_artifact"."source_event_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 256
        AND length(trim("private_artifact"."source_message_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 256
        AND length(trim("private_artifact"."source_media_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 256
        AND length(trim("private_artifact"."filename")) BETWEEN 1 AND 256
        AND length(trim("private_artifact"."media_type")) BETWEEN 1 AND 128

browser_image_artifacts_ready_fields_che.name: browser_image_artifacts_ready_fields_check
browser_image_artifacts_ready_fields_che.value: "browser_image_artifacts"."status" = 'pending' OR ("browser_image_artifacts"."filename" IS NOT NULL AND "browser_image_artifacts"."media_type" IS NOT NULL AND "browser_image_artifacts"."byte_size" > 0 AND "browser_image_artifacts"."content_hash" IS NOT NULL)

channel_auth_challenge_purpose_check.name: channel_auth_challenge_purpose_check
channel_auth_challenge_purpose_check.value:
("channel_auth_challenge"."purpose" = 'login' AND "channel_auth_challenge"."target_user_id" IS NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."requesting_session_id" IS NULL) OR (
        "channel_auth_challenge"."purpose" = 'link' AND (
          ("channel_auth_challenge"."intended_identity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."browser_bound_at" IS NULL
            AND "channel_auth_challenge"."target_user_id" IS NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."requesting_session_id" IS NULL)
          OR (("channel_auth_challenge"."intended_identity_id" IS NULL OR "channel_auth_challenge"."browser_bound_at" IS NOT NULL)
            AND "channel_auth_challenge"."target_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."requesting_session_id" IS NOT NULL)
        )
      )

channel_auth_challenge_hash_check.name: channel_auth_challenge_hash_check
channel_auth_challenge_hash_check.value: "channel_auth_challenge"."token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ("channel_auth_challenge"."browser_secret_hash" IS NULL OR "channel_auth_challenge"."browser_secret_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND ("channel_auth_challenge"."entry_token_hash" IS NULL OR "channel_auth_challenge"."entry_token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

channel_auth_challenge_native_check.name: channel_auth_challenge_native_check
channel_auth_challenge_native_check.value:
(
        "channel_auth_challenge"."intended_identity_id" IS NULL
        AND "channel_auth_challenge"."entry_token_hash" IS NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."browser_bound_at" IS NULL
        AND "channel_auth_challenge"."source_session_id" IS NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."source_call_id" IS NULL
        AND "channel_auth_challenge"."browser_secret_hash" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "channel_auth_challenge"."intended_identity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."purpose" IN ('login', 'link')
        AND "channel_auth_challenge"."source_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("channel_auth_challenge"."source_session_id")) > 0
        AND "channel_auth_challenge"."source_call_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("channel_auth_challenge"."source_call_id")) > 0
        AND (
          ("channel_auth_challenge"."browser_bound_at" IS NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."browser_secret_hash" IS NULL
            AND "channel_auth_challenge"."entry_token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("channel_auth_challenge"."browser_bound_at" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."browser_secret_hash" IS NOT NULL
            AND "channel_auth_challenge"."entry_token_hash" IS NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."browser_bound_at" >= "channel_auth_challenge"."created_at"
            AND "channel_auth_challenge"."browser_bound_at" < "channel_auth_challenge"."expires_at")
        )
        AND ("channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_at" IS NULL OR "channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_at" >= "channel_auth_challenge"."browser_bound_at")
        AND ("channel_auth_challenge"."identity_id" IS NULL OR "channel_auth_challenge"."identity_id" = "channel_auth_challenge"."intended_identity_id")
      )

channel_auth_challenge_confirmation_chec.name: channel_auth_challenge_confirmation_check
channel_auth_challenge_confirmation_chec.value: ("channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_sender_id" IS NULL) OR ("channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_sender_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_sender_id")) > 0)

channel_auth_challenge_consumption_check.name: channel_auth_challenge_consumption_check
channel_auth_challenge_consumption_check.value: "channel_auth_challenge"."consumed_at" IS NULL OR ("channel_auth_challenge"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."identity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_challenge"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

channel_auth_prompt_ciphertext_check.name: channel_auth_prompt_ciphertext_check
channel_auth_prompt_ciphertext_check.value: ("channel_auth_prompt"."status" IN ('queued', 'dispatching') AND "channel_auth_prompt"."token_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND length("channel_auth_prompt"."token_ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 8192) OR ("channel_auth_prompt"."status" IN ('sent', 'uncertain', 'failed', 'cancelled') AND "channel_auth_prompt"."token_ciphertext" IS NULL)

channel_auth_prompt_lease_check.name: channel_auth_prompt_lease_check
channel_auth_prompt_lease_check.value: ("channel_auth_prompt"."status" = 'dispatching' AND "channel_auth_prompt"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_prompt"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("channel_auth_prompt"."status" <> 'dispatching' AND "channel_auth_prompt"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "channel_auth_prompt"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

channel_auth_prompt_sent_check.name: channel_auth_prompt_sent_check
channel_auth_prompt_sent_check.value: "channel_auth_prompt"."status" <> 'sent' OR ("channel_auth_prompt"."provider_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_auth_prompt"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL)

channel_inbox_native_input_check.name: channel_inbox_native_input_check
channel_inbox_native_input_check.value:
"channel_inbox"."native_input" IS NULL OR COALESCE(
        jsonb_typeof("channel_inbox"."native_input") = 'object'
        AND "channel_inbox"."native_input"->>'protocol' = 'eve-keyed-input-v1'
        AND "channel_inbox"."native_input"->>'inputId' = "channel_inbox"."id"::text
        AND "channel_inbox"."native_input"->>'address' = "channel_inbox"."identity_id"::text, false)

channel_inbox_lease_check.name: channel_inbox_lease_check
channel_inbox_lease_check.value: "channel_inbox"."status" <> 'dispatching' OR ("channel_inbox"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_inbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

channel_inbox_accepted_check.name: channel_inbox_accepted_check
channel_inbox_accepted_check.value: "channel_inbox"."status" <> 'accepted' OR ("channel_inbox"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_inbox"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

channel_outbox_lease_check.name: channel_outbox_lease_check
channel_outbox_lease_check.value: "channel_outbox"."status" <> 'dispatching' OR ("channel_outbox"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

channel_outbox_sent_check.name: channel_outbox_sent_check
channel_outbox_sent_check.value: "channel_outbox"."status" <> 'sent' OR ("channel_outbox"."provider_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_outbox"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL)
